title: Guidelines for preventive activities in general practice (Red Book), 10th edition
key_points: The reference for what to screen, when, and what NOT to screen. GRADE-based recommendations; expanded women's health across the reproductive lifespan.
thresholds: Cervical 25-74 5-yearly HPV; bowel 45-74 2-yearly iFOBT; breast 50-74 2-yearly (40+ eligible); BP checks at every visit; CVD risk 45-74 (30+ ATSI); T2DM screening by risk (every 3 years from 40, or 18 in high-risk groups).
exam_relevance: AKT asks screening intervals/thresholds directly; KFP builds screening-consultation cases; CCE uses screening conversations.

title: Australian Asthma Handbook
key_points: SABA-only treatment is out; ICS-formoterol reliever/maintenance (AIR) for most; assessment of severity/control; written action plans.
thresholds: Reliever use >2x/week = poor control; preventer indicated.
exam_relevance: Recurring AKT topic and common KFP scenario (the SABA-overuser).

title: Therapeutic Guidelines (eTG complete)
key_points: The antibiotic reference for Australian GP: first-line choices for common infections, durations, and allergy alternatives.
thresholds: Antibiotic choices, durations, and when not to treat.
exam_relevance: Directly examinable: first-line antibiotic choices for UTI, cellulitis, pneumonia, sore throat.

title: Australian Immunisation Handbook
key_points: 21vPCV replaced 13vPCV/23vPPV in adult schedule (2026); RSV program expansion; MenB (with paracetamol prophylaxis); catch-up rules.
thresholds: NIP schedule ages; valid contraindications; minimum intervals.
exam_relevance: AKT favourite: schedule ages, contraindications, catch-up logic.

title: 2023 Australian Guideline for assessing and managing cardiovascular disease risk
key_points: Absolute risk approach using Aus CVD Risk Calculator; assess from 45 (30 ATSI); statin decisions by risk band not LDL alone.
thresholds: Low <10%, moderate 10-15%, high >15% (5-year). High risk: treat. Diabetes >=50, established CVD, CKD, FH = treat regardless.
exam_relevance: Core AKT/KFP territory: who gets a statin.

title: Australian Clinical Guidelines for Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
key_points: CHA2DS2-VA (no sex category - Australian change); opportunistic screening pulse/ECG >65; rate vs rhythm.
thresholds: Anticoagulate CHA2DS2-VA >=2 (>=1 in some higher-risk contexts).
exam_relevance: AKT: anticoagulation threshold and DOAC choice; KFP: AF review cases.

title: COPD-X (Australian and New Zealand guidelines for COPD)
key_points: Confirm with spirometry; smoking cessation changes trajectory; pulmonary rehab; inhaler step-up by exacerbations/eosinophils.
thresholds: Post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC <0.7 = diagnosis; ICS if eos >=0.3 or >=2 exacerbations.
exam_relevance: AKT: step-up logic. KFP: the frequent exacerbator.

title: Australian STI Management Guidelines for Use in Primary Care
key_points: Site-specific NAAT testing, first-line treatments (as per eTG align), partner notification duties.
thresholds: Screening intervals by risk; test of cure intervals.
exam_relevance: AKT: STI treatment choices; CCE: sexual history technique.

title: National Cervical Screening Program: Guidelines for the management of screen-detected abnormalities
key_points: HPV-based screening; self-collection equality; intermediate/higher-risk pathways; exit testing 70-74.
thresholds: 25-74, 5-yearly; self-collected samples with HPV (not 16/18) require return for LBC.
exam_relevance: AKT: program intervals; KFP: the overdue/anxious screener.

title: Comprehensive Australian Clinical Guideline for ACS (2025)
key_points: New 2025 guideline: ACS pathways, DAPT duration choices, secondary prevention bundle, DOAC+antiplatelet strategies in AF+ACS.
thresholds: DAPT duration by bleeding/ischaemic risk; step-down strategies.
exam_relevance: AKT: post-ACS medication bundles.

title: Guideline for diagnosis and management of hypertension in adults (2016)
key_points: Confirm before treating; out-of-office measurement; absolute risk context; new 2026 guideline due Q4 2026 - watch for changes.
thresholds: Diagnosis generally >=140/90 clinic confirmed; management by absolute risk.
exam_relevance: AKT: who to treat; KFP: white-coat scenario.

title: Australian guideline for MASLD (fatty liver)
key_points: FIB-4 first-line fibrosis staging; 7-10% weight loss core therapy; cardiovascular risk is the main driver of mortality in MASLD.
thresholds: FIB-4 <1.3 low risk (age <65); elastography if intermediate.
exam_relevance: KFP: abnormal LFT cases; AKT: diagnosis pattern.

title: RACGP Silver Book - Medical care of older persons in residential aged care facilities
key_points: RACF-specific: advance care planning, deprescribing, falls, palliative, behaviour management (avoid chemical restraint).
thresholds: Frailty-aware targets; restrictive practice minimisation.
exam_relevance: CCE loves RACF scenarios; KFP older-person cases.

title: Austroads Assessing Fitness to Drive
key_points: Standards for medical conditions and driving: dementia, epilepsy, diabetes, sleep apnoea, CVD, alcohol. Both patient and practitioner notification duties.
thresholds: Private vs commercial standards differ; e.g., diabetes on insulin: 5-yearly review.
exam_relevance: AKT/CCE: the driving conversation is high-yield CCE.

title: RANZCOG pregnancy care guidelines / antenatal care
key_points: Antenatal visit schedule, screening tests each trimester, medication safety in pregnancy.
thresholds: First visit by 10-12 weeks; GTT 24-28 weeks; anti-D timings.
exam_relevance: AKT: antenatal schedule/test timing.

title: Type 2 diabetes management in general practice
key_points: ADD-STEP comorbidity-based agent selection; annual cycle of care; individualised targets.
thresholds: HbA1c generally <=7%; retinal/foot/ACR annually.
exam_relevance: Core of multiple AKT questions and KFP reviews.

title: Kidney Health Australia - CKD management in primary care
key_points: eGFR + ACR staging; RAAS blockade with albuminuria; SGLT2i; nephrology referral criteria.
thresholds: Refer if eGFR <30, ACR >60, rapid decline, or haematuria + proteinuria.
exam_relevance: KFP: CKD review case; AKT: referral thresholds.

title: Voluntary Assisted Dying (QLD)
key_points: VAD legal in QLD since Jan 2023: eligibility (adult, resident, decision-capable, intolerable suffering from advanced condition), first/second request process, coordinating practitioner role, conscientious objection rights for doctors.
thresholds: Eligibility is assessed - not all requests proceed; process is strictly legal.
exam_relevance: CCE ethics stations; AKT legal questions.

title: eTG Palliative Care / Therapeutic Guidelines Palliative Care
key_points: Anticipatory prescribing sets, terminal care pathways, symptom algorithms.
thresholds: Dosing conversions opioid routes.
exam_relevance: KFP palliative cases; AKT symptom drug choices.

title: RCH Clinical Practice Guidelines (Paediatrics)
key_points: Practical paediatric protocols: fever, bronchiolitis, croup, gastro, asthma, head injury, analgesia dosing.
thresholds: Weight-based dosing; referral criteria.
exam_relevance: AKT paediatric dosing and criteria; KFP child cases.

title: RACGP Green Book - Putting prevention into practice
key_points: How to build prevention into practice systems rather than individual willpower.
thresholds: Practice-level recall and reminder systems.
exam_relevance: Occasional AKT on practice systems.

title: White Book - Abuse and violence: working with our patients
key_points: How to ask, respond, safety-assess, document, and refer for FDV; practice-level safety.
thresholds: Strangulation = high risk marker.
exam_relevance: CCE FDV station is common; KFP documentation/management questions.
